title: Last Week in Swamp Club: week of Oct 19 – Oct 25, 2026
disclaimer: Generated automatically from public swamp registry data. Summaries are machine-written descriptions of each change, not reviews, and can be wrong; the registry and the extension's source are authoritative. Authors can leave the digest by adding the `no-digest` label to their extension.

items.name: @bixu/cull
items.summary: A new extension, @bixu/cull, was added in its first release, version 2026.10.22.1. It provides a single method, cull, which scores a Canon R5 II card or ingest folder by sharpness and in-camera rating and copies the keepers.

items.name: @bixu/invariant-encoding-check
items.summary: The new invariant-encoding-check extension, first released as 2026.10.22.1, adds a check method that fails CI when a changed model file leaves a known invariant unencoded in its zod schema. It also provides shared zod schemas for Sha256Digest, Platform, and SshFingerprint.

items.name: @bmonty/text-entropy
items.summary: A new extension, @bmonty/text-entropy, was released as version 2026.10.22.1. It adds one method, analyze, which measures the Shannon entropy of a piece of text.

items.name: @cachehit/techdocs
items.summary: This is a first release of @cachehit/techdocs, which adds four methods for searching and building AI context from a Hugo documentation site, including get_doc, search, sync, and build_context. It reads content from a GitLab repository or a local checkout and supports Docsy or other Hugo themes.

items.name: @figy/blog
items.summary: A new extension, @figy/blog, first released as version 2026.10.24.1 and updated to 2026.10.24.2 within this window. It renders Markdown posts from an Obsidian vault folder and publishes them on Cloudflare Pages.

items.name: @hmcrum/nfl-player-stats
items.summary: New extension @hmcrum/nfl-player-stats (first release, version 2026.10.22.1) reads real NFL player box-score statistics from ESPN's public summary endpoint, and adds two methods: box_score and week_stats.

items.name: @keeb/exa
items.summary: The @keeb/exa extension, first released as version 2026.10.24.1, adds two methods for agents: search, which runs any Exa web search, and find_people, which looks up LinkedIn profiles in bulk by running one people-category search per person.

items.name: @keeb/scenerules
items.summary: @keeb/scenerules is a first release that mirrors scenerules.org as a swamp model, providing the full ruleset catalogue, site and document pages, full-text search, and rule lookup by number.

items.name: @magistr/mitmproxy
items.summary: A new extension, @magistr/mitmproxy, was published as its first release and adds seven methods for installing, starting, stopping, and inspecting a local mitmproxy HTTP/HTTPS intercepting proxy, plus trusting its CA and clearing captured flows.

items.name: @magistr/openssl
items.summary: The @magistr/openssl extension is a first release, adding eight methods that inspect, create, sign, verify, and convert X.509 material through the local openssl CLI: convert, csr, genkey, inspect, selfsign, sign, verify, and version. The later 2026.10.25.10 version is a repo-wide republish with no functional change.

items.name: @puddleworks/puddleworks-factory
items.summary: This is the first release of the Puddleworks Factory extension, version 2026.10.23.1. It adds a draft.run method that builds the first draft of a swamp app from an app spec, which can be read from a file, a URL, or inline JSON, and can prefill that spec from an agreed outcome spec.

items.name: @reset/buildq
items.summary: This is a first release of @reset/buildq, a client for driving a buildq coordinator over its HTTP API in a Buildkite-style shape. It adds eleven methods for listing and reading builds, job logs, artifacts and annotations, the queue and agents, and for rebuilding, cancelling and unblocking builds.

items.name: @reset/cheapshark-deals
items.summary: A new first release, version 2026.10.24.1, adds the @reset/cheapshark-deals extension, which records PC game prices across CheapShark's stores and flags price drops. It provides three methods: sample, search, and summarise.

items.name: @reset/crates-downloads
items.summary: Records crates.io crate downloads and versions over time through two methods, sample and summarise. This is the extension's first release, version 2026.10.24.1.

items.name: @reset/discord-webhook
items.summary: This is a first release of the @reset/discord-webhook extension, version 2026.10.22.2, that adds a single method, send, for posting a message with embeds to a Discord webhook from a workflow.

items.name: @reset/dockerhub-pulls
items.summary: The new @reset/dockerhub-pulls extension, first released as version 2026.10.24.1, records Docker Hub image pulls, stars and tags over time. It adds two methods: sample, which takes a snapshot, and summarise, which reports on the recorded data.

items.name: @reset/epic
items.summary: The new @reset/epic extension was released at version 2026.10.22.2 and samples Epic Games Store prices and discounts while recording free games. It adds three methods: freeGames, sample, and summarise.

items.name: @reset/fmod
items.summary: Adds the first release of @reset/fmod, which drives FMOD Studio's command line tool from Swamp to build sound banks for named platforms, list a project's platforms, banks and events, and run the tool's project validation.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-commits
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/forgejo-commits, was released at version 2026.10.24.1. It records a Forgejo or Gitea branch's commits and head over time, and adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-issues
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/forgejo-issues, has been released for the first time at version 2026.10.24.1. It records open issue counts for Forgejo or Gitea repositories over time, and adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-pulls
items.summary: The @reset/forgejo-pulls extension is a first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that drives pull requests on Forgejo or Gitea forges.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-releases
items.summary: Records Forgejo and Gitea releases and their asset downloads. Initial release adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-repo-stats
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/forgejo-repo-stats, was released at version 2026.10.24.1. It records star and counter values for Forgejo or Gitea repositories over time, and adds two methods: sample, which captures the values, and summarise, which reports on them.

items.name: @reset/github-releases
items.summary: This is the first release of the @reset/github-releases extension, version 2026.10.22.1. It records GitHub releases and asset downloads and summarises them, through two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/godot
items.summary: First release of this extension, which drives the Godot 4 editor headlessly from its command line. It adds methods to read the engine version and project settings, reimport assets, read export presets, export a preset, and parse GDScript files, each written as a resource.

items.name: @reset/godot-assets
items.summary: This is a new extension, @reset/godot-assets, first released as version 2026.10.23.1. It records versions and ratings of Godot Asset Library assets over time, with two methods added: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/gog
items.summary: The @reset/gog extension is a first release, now at version 2026.10.22.2, that samples a GOG product's store data and summarises its price history. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/hackernews-mentions
items.summary: This is a first release of @reset/hackernews-mentions, version 2026.10.24.1. It records Hacker News mentions of a game, studio or product, and adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/homebrew-installs
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/homebrew-installs, was released as its first version, 2026.10.24.1. It records Homebrew formula and cask installs and versions over time, and adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/itch
items.summary: Records itch.io games and their channel versions along with what changed, offering three methods: @reset/itch.credentials, @reset/itch.games, and @reset/itch.latest. This is the first release, published as version 2026.10.22.1 and then updated to 2026.10.22.2 within the same window.

items.name: @reset/lemmy-mentions
items.summary: Lemmy Mentions is a first release that records Lemmy mentions of a game, studio or product. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/mastodon-hashtags
items.summary: This new extension, @reset/mastodon-hashtags, is an initial release that records how often a Mastodon instance's hashtags are used and how many posts they appear in over time. It adds two methods: sample, which collects those hashtag figures, and summarise, which reports on them.

items.name: @reset/modio
items.summary: @reset/modio is a new extension, first released as version 2026.10.23.1, that records a game's mods and their mod.io statistics and summarises their growth. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/npm-downloads
items.summary: Initial release of @reset/npm-downloads (version 2026.10.24.1), which records daily download counts and latest versions for npm packages over time. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/nuget-downloads
items.summary: The @reset/nuget-downloads extension is a new first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that records NuGet package downloads and latest versions over time. It adds two methods, sample and summarise, for collecting and reporting that data.

items.name: @reset/patch-notes
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/patch-notes, was released as its first version, 2026.10.22.1. It posts each new patch note for a Steam game to Discord as a separate embed.

items.name: @reset/protondb
items.summary: This new extension, @reset/protondb, is an initial release that samples a Steam game's ProtonDB tier and score and summarises them, using the methods sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/pypi-downloads
items.summary: This new extension records daily download counts and latest versions for PyPI projects. It adds two methods: one that produces a sample of the recorded data and one that summarises it.

items.name: @reset/rollbar
items.summary: The @reset/rollbar extension is a first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that drives Rollbar-compatible crash-reporting APIs. It can list and read items, occurrences and item events, resolve, mute and assign items, record deploys, and read occurrence, activation and top-item reports, each written as a resource.

items.name: @reset/sentry-issues
items.summary: Records a Sentry project's top issues and how their event counts grow over time. Adds two methods, sample and summarise. This is the first release, version 2026.10.23.1.

items.name: @reset/socialq
items.summary: The @reset/socialq extension is a first release, adding eight methods that read a socialq deployment over its HTTP API using a Cloudflare Access service token. The methods cover health, token identity, accounts, calendar and recorder coverage, the wrap-up report, daily activity, the job ledger, and the taxonomy.

items.name: @reset/speedrun-leaderboards
items.summary: Records speedrun.com leaderboards over time and tracks record changes. This first release, version 2026.10.24.1, adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/steam
items.summary: The @reset/steam extension is a first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that uploads a game's builds to Steam and sets them live on a branch. It adds four methods: betas, builds, setLive, and upload.

items.name: @reset/steam-achievements
items.summary: Initial release of @reset/steam-achievements, version 2026.10.22.2, which adds two methods: sample, to sample a Steam app's achievement unlock rates, and summarise, to summarise those rates. The window also includes version 2026.10.22.1.

items.name: @reset/steam-news
items.summary: New extension that records a Steam app's news and patch notes and flags newly posted items. Its initial release shipped as versions 2026.10.22.1 and 2026.10.22.2, adding fetch and list methods.

items.name: @reset/steam-players
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/steam-players, samples a Steam app's concurrent player count and summarises the history, with methods sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/steam-reviews
items.summary: The @reset/steam-reviews extension is a new first release, now at version 2026.10.22.2 after a earlier 2026.10.22.1 build. It adds two methods: sample, which records a Steam app's review score, and summarise, which summarises that score history.

items.name: @reset/steam-workshop
items.summary: The new @reset/steam-workshop extension, released as version 2026.10.22.1, samples a Steam Workshop item's public stats and summarises them. It adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/steamspy
items.summary: This first release of @reset/steamspy adds two methods, sample and summarise, for sampling an app's SteamSpy estimates and summarising how they change over time.

items.name: @reset/steamworks-builds
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/steamworks-builds, was released as version 2026.10.23.1 to record a Steam app's branches and builds and how they move between them. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/steamworks-sales
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/steamworks-sales, makes its first release at version 2026.10.23.1. It records a Steam partner's daily sales aggregates through a sample method and summarises them with a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/steamworks-wishlists
items.summary: The @reset/steamworks-wishlists extension is a new first release, version 2026.10.23.1, that records and summarises a Steam app's daily wishlist activity. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/twitch-viewers
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/twitch-viewers, ships its first release (2026.10.23.1) to record and summarise a game's live Twitch streams and viewer counts. It adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/unity
items.summary: This is a first release of the @reset/unity extension, published as version 2026.10.24.1.

items.name: @reset/workq
items.summary: The first release of @reset/workq, published as version 2026.10.24.1, adds eleven methods for driving workq's work-tracking API as a service caller.

items.name: @reset/wwise
items.summary: The @reset/wwise extension is a first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that drives an open Wwise Authoring instance through WAAPI over WAMP.

items.name: @skunk-ape/hermes
items.summary: This is the first release of @skunk-ape/hermes, which runs Hermes agents on macOS or Linux with each agent confined to its own directory by a nono sandbox.

items.name: @skunk-ape/web-brief
items.summary: The @skunk-ape/web-brief extension is a new initial release, version 2026.10.24.1, that gives an autonomous agent web access without a browser. It adds two methods, fetch and summarize.

items.name: @sntxrr/docker-ps
items.summary: This is the first release of @sntxrr/docker-ps, now at version 2026.10.25.1, and it adds one method, host.ps. The extension provides a read-only listing of containers on a Docker host over SSH, scoped narrowly enough for an unattended triage agent to use.

items.name: @sntxrr/log-tail
items.summary: This is a first release of @sntxrr/log-tail, now at version 2026.10.25.1. It reads the last lines of a log selected by name from an allowlist fixed in the model definition, with secret values redacted. It adds two methods: allowlist.list and allowlist.tail.

items.name: @sntxrr/traefik
items.summary: A first release of @sntxrr/traefik, version 2026.10.25.1, adds three methods: instance.bump, instance.check and instance.inspect.

items.name: @sntxrr/uptime-kuma
items.summary: A new extension, @sntxrr/uptime-kuma, provides read-only access to Uptime Kuma monitor history for triage. It returns the last N heartbeats for one monitor, including status, time, message, and ping, along with a summary of current status, when it last changed, and how many changes occurred in the window.

items.name: @svendowideit/cloudflare-pages-wrangler
items.summary: The new extension @svendowideit/cloudflare-pages-wrangler is a first release, now at version 2026.10.24.2, that adds methods for deploying sites directly to Cloudflare Pages without a Git repository, creating projects, and binding custom domains.

items.name: @svendowideit/markdown2html
items.summary: This is a first release of @svendowideit/markdown2html, version 2026.10.24.2 in the window, which adds the generate method. It renders Markdown files into a static HTML site with an index page, without requiring Python or special content markers.

items.name: @svendowideit/s3-archive-planner
items.summary: A new extension, @svendowideit/s3-archive-planner (version 2026.10.25.1, first release), plans an Australian photo and video archive on Amazon S3.

items.name: @svendowideit/ssh-key-inventory
items.summary: A new extension, @svendowideit/ssh-key-inventory, was published as its first release at version 2026.10.24.2. It inventories, assesses and helps safely replace SSH private keys across hosts reachable from a control account, producing an HTML report with per-key remediation advice.

items.name: @swamp/aws/licensemanagerusersubscriptions
items.summary: The new @swamp/aws/licensemanagerusersubscriptions extension ships AWS License Manager User Subscriptions infrastructure models, with a license_server_endpoint model that provides create, delete, get, list, sync and update methods.

items.name: @swamp/cve
items.summary: Initial release that adds methods to scan and mitigate Linux, macOS, and Windows hosts and Linux containers still trusting eight eMudhra intermediate CAs whose private keys were compromised, plus a fleet-wide scan.

items.name: @swamp/gcp/deepreview
items.summary: Google Cloud deepreview models are added in this first release, covering documents and document reviews with create, get, list, sync, and delete operations. The 2026.10.23.1 version also includes updates to the documents and documents-reviews models.

items.name: @taylor/emudhra
items.summary: Initial release of an extension whose exposure.scan method checks where the leaked private keys of eight compromised eMudhra certificate authorities can still be used against you.

items.name: @taylor/libvirt
items.summary: A new extension, @taylor/libvirt (first release, version 2026.10.24.2), sets up an Ubuntu host to run KVM/QEMU virtual machines via libvirt. It provides check and apply methods for the host packages and user groups, directory storage pools, networks, uplinks, and virtual machines.

items.name: @vcjdeboer/opentofu
items.summary: The @vcjdeboer/opentofu extension is a first release that adds methods to plan, apply, initialize, validate, read outputs from, and check the version of OpenTofu, with plan and apply gated by a sha-bound check. Versions 2026.10.22.1 through 2026.10.23.2 were published in this window.

items.name: @vcjdeboer/quarto-deck
items.summary: Initial release of @vcjdeboer/quarto-deck, a tool for making Quarto reveal.js lecture decks build the same way each time and keep a record of how each was built. It adds 16 methods covering rendering, PDF and PPTX export, PPTX import and inspection, slide and source management, outlining, and checks.

items.name: @webframp/anthropic/admin
items.summary: The @webframp/anthropic/admin extension is a first release that lets you manage members of a Claude Enterprise organization through the Admin API, including reading members, custom roles, and RBAC groups, adding members to groups, and switching members between User and Custom roles.

items.name: @webframp/aws/php2shell-hunt
items.summary: A new AWS extension, @webframp/aws/php2shell-hunt (version 2026.10.22.1), is an initial release that checks AWS accounts for exposure and indicators of compromise tied to the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

items.name: @webframp/editorial-review
items.summary: A new extension, @webframp/editorial-review, was released at version 2026.10.21.1. It reviews prose against a bundled set of editorial principles, using a model pass with an optional second pass, and produces structured findings plus a revised draft with a report.

items.name: @webframp/presentation
items.summary: Introduces @webframp/presentation, a first release that builds reveal.js 6.0.1 decks from Org or Markdown, stores each build, outline and PDF as versioned swamp data, and adds build, outline and export_pdf methods.

items.name: @zts/cataas
items.summary: A new extension, @zts/cataas, was first released in version 2026.10.25.1 and updated to 2026.10.25.2, adding one method, random, which fetches a random cat image from the Cat as a Service site.

items.name: @zts/text-entropy

items.summary: A new extension, @zts/trello-tracker, makes its first release (version 2026.10.25.1) as a stagecraft tracker that keeps a factory's tickets on one Trello board, with cards as tickets, open lists as statuses, and labels as ticket types. It adds two methods, describe and operate.

items.title: October 19th, 2026 — AI Frontiers
items.description: Episode 12 of AI Frontiers with Matthew Dean Furlo. Industry experts run down all the AI news for engineers. Adam Jacob, Paul Stack, and Nick Stinemates…

items.title: Gatekeeping in the Age of AI
items.author: stack72
items.summary: Every shift in software has been told it’s already solved. With AI, that pushback has become gatekeeping, and it risks talking us out of the biggest chance in decades to change how we build.

items.title: Asking swamp first, even for this blog — Notes
items.author: tagur
items.summary: Why I reach for swamp first, how I built this blog with it, and what I still need to work out before using it for network changes.

items.title: How Much of Your Software Factory Can Run in the Dark?
items.author: stack72
items.summary: Our lights-on software factory builds systems we want to operate with the lights off. We work through the responsibility we’re giving those systems, build it into the operation and let them run. When something new comes back, we have more work to do in the software factory.

items.title: Setting up Swamp in a C# and Unity shop · reset.dev
items.author: reset
items.summary: A developer documents the first-day experience configuring Swamp, a TypeScript-based automation CLI, in a C# and Unity game studio, covering installation quirks, behavior and workflow setup, agent scoping with --tool none, and telemetry transparency.

items.title: Telling swamp what I want
items.author: svendowideit
items.summary: A developer builds a custom swamp workflow that converts Obsidian markdown blog posts to HTML and publishes them to Cloudflare Pages with automatic DNS setup via Caddy, without requiring a separate git repository.
